title: Iron Man
plot: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

title: The Incredible Hulk
plot: Bruce Banner, a scientist on the run from the US Government, must find a cure for the monster he turns into whenever he loses his temper.

title: Iron Man 2
plot: With the world now aware of his identity as Iron Man, Tony Stark must contend with both his declining health and a vengeful mad man.

title: Thor
plot: The powerful but arrogant god Thor is cast out of Asgard to live amongst humans, where he learns what it takes to be a true hero.

title: Captain America: The First Avenger
plot: Steve Rogers, a rejected military soldier, transforms into Captain America after taking a dose of a 'Super-Soldier serum'.

title: The Avengers
plot: Earth's mightiest heroes must come together to stop Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity.

title: Iron Man 3
plot: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist, he starts an odyssey to rebuild and re-examine his life.

title: Thor: The Dark World
plot: Thor must team up with Loki to save Asgard and the Nine Realms from a race of ancient enemies.

title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
plot: As Steve Rogers struggles to embrace his role in the modern world, he teams up with a fellow Avenger to battle a new threat.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy
plot: A group of intergalactic misfits must band together to save the galaxy from a fanatical warrior.
